title: Create Amazed Smart Observer
description: Makes the Smart Observer from Create have a O.O face when active.
body:
This basic resource pack edits the Smart Observer of the [Create Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) to have an amazed (O.O) face when activated... That's literally it.

## Credits and notice for moderators

Original Credit and (C) go to the Create Mod Team for the original Smart Observer Assets.
This resource pack has been published with the approval of the Create Mod Team.
A copyright notice is included in the resource pack as credits.txt

See this issue on GitHub for details: https://github.com/Creators-of-Create/Create/issues/9594

## Can I use this in modpacks?

Absolutely. Just be sure to give credit to this resource page!
